sheet.title: Enquiry and Lead Tracker
sheet.intro: Keep every enquiry in one place. Add who asked, where they came from, what they want and what it is worth. Set the next follow-up date and the tracker shows who is overdue, with a WhatsApp link to message them. Counts by stage and source, and your win rate, fill in by themselves. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name and the follow-up message. Open Lists and check the sources where enquiries come from. The stages are New, Contacted, Quote sent, Won and Lost.
Open Leads. Add a row for each enquiry: the date, name, phone, source, what they want, the value, and the stage. Pick the source and stage from the lists.
Type the next follow-up date. The Follow-up column shows Overdue, Today or Upcoming, and the Chat link opens WhatsApp with your message ready. You press send yourself.

Move the stage as things happen. Summary shows open leads, their value, what you have won, your win rate and charts by stage and source. Use the filter on the Follow-up heading to see who to call today.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam aur follow-up message likhein. Lists mein dekhein ki enquiry kahan se aati hain. Stages hain: New, Contacted, Quote sent, Won aur Lost.
Leads kholein. Har enquiry ke liye ek row: tareekh, naam, phone, source, kya chahiye, value aur stage. Source aur stage list se chunein.
Agla follow-up date likhein. Follow-up column mein Overdue, Today ya Upcoming dikhta hai, aur Chat link se WhatsApp message tayyar khulta hai. Send aap khud dabate hain.
Jaise-jaise kaam badhe, stage badalte rahein. Summary mein open leads, unki value, jeete hue kaam, win rate aur chart dikhte hain. Aaj kiske ko call karna hai ye Follow-up ke filter se dekhein.

sheet.title: Expense Claim Sheet
sheet.intro: List what you spent, pick a category, and mark whether you have the receipt. Each claim is checked against the limit for its category, tracked as Pending, Approved, Rejected or Paid, and added up by category. Print it for approval. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type the organisation, the claimant name and the period, for example November 2026. Open Categories and list your expense types, with a limit per claim if you want one.
Open Claims. Add a row for each expense: the date, what it was, the category, the amount and whether you have the receipt. The limit and a check appear next to it.
The person approving changes the Status to Approved, Rejected or Paid. Use the filter on the Status heading to see what is still pending.
Summary shows the total claimed, approved, paid and still to pay, and the amounts for each category. Print it or save as PDF to send with the receipts.
guideHi: Settings mein sanstha, claim karne wale ka naam aur period likhein. Categories mein kharche ke type likhein, chaho to har claim ki limit bhi.
Claims kholein. Har kharche ke liye ek row: tareekh, kya tha, category, rakam aur receipt hai ya nahi. Limit aur check saath mein dikhte hain.
Approve karne wala Status ko Approved, Rejected ya Paid karta hai. Status ke filter se dekhein ki kya pending hai.
Summary mein kitna claim hua, approve hua, paid hua aur dena baaki hai, aur category ke hisaab se rakam dikhti hai. Receipts ke saath bhejne ke liye print ya PDF karein.

sheet.title: Job and Order Tracker
sheet.intro: Keep track of every job or custom order: who it is for, what it is, the amount, the advance taken, the balance and the due date. Overdue and due-soon jobs are flagged, and Summary shows what is open and how much you still have to collect. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type your business name and how many days before the due date you want a warning. Open Customers and list the people you work for.
Open Jobs. Add a row for each order: a job number, the date received, the customer, what it is, the amount, any advance and the due date. The balance is worked out for you.

Change the Status as the work moves: Received, In progress, Ready, Delivered or Cancelled. Overdue and Due soon flags show on jobs that are not finished. Use the filter on Status to see what is ready for pickup.
Summary shows open jobs, overdue and due-soon jobs, what is ready, and the balance still to collect. The Payment column shows Paid, Part paid or Unpaid for each job.
guideHi: Settings mein business ka naam aur due date se kitne din pehle chetavni chahiye wo likhein. Customers mein apne customers likhein.
Jobs kholein. Har order ke liye ek row: job number, kab aaya, customer, kya hai, rakam, advance aur due date. Balance apne aap nikalta hai.
Kaam badhne par Status badlein: Received, In progress, Ready, Delivered ya Cancelled. Adhoore kaam par Overdue aur Due soon dikhta hai. Status ke filter se dekhein kya taiyar hai.
Summary mein open jobs, overdue aur due soon jobs, taiyar jobs aur vasool karna baaki balance dikhta hai. Payment column mein Paid, Part paid ya Unpaid dikhta hai.

sheet.title: Vehicle Log Book
sheet.intro: Write down each trip or fill-up with the start and end reading of the meter. The log works out the distance, the cost per km and the kilometres per litre, and Totals shows each vehicle. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type the business or owner name. Open Vehicles and list each vehicle with its registration number.

Open Log. For each trip or fill-up add a row: the date, the vehicle, what it was for, the meter reading at the start and at the end, and the litres and cost of any fuel. Add other costs such as tolls or repairs in Other cost.
The sheet works out the distance, the total cost, the cost per km and the km per litre. A red check appears if the end reading is lower than the start.
Totals shows each vehicle: distance, fuel, other costs, cost per km and average km per litre. Use it to see which vehicle costs the most to run.
guideHi: Settings mein business ya malik ka naam likhein. Vehicles mein har gaadi ka naam aur number likhein.
Log kholein. Har trip ya fuel ke liye ek row: tareekh, gaadi, kis kaam ke liye, meter shuru aur ant ki reading, aur fuel ke litre aur kharcha. Toll ya repair jaise kharche Other cost mein likhein.
Sheet doori, kul kharcha, kharcha prati km aur km prati litre nikalti hai. Agar ant ki reading shuru se kam ho to laal check dikhta hai.
Totals mein har gaadi ki doori, fuel, doosre kharche, kharcha prati km aur average km prati litre dikhte hain. Dekhein kaun si gaadi sabse mehngi padti hai.
about: Every trip or fill-up with distance, cost and mileage.
Distance, cost and mileage for each vehicle.

sheet.logSub: One row for each trip or fill-up. Type the meter reading at the start and at the end.

sheet.totalsSub: Distance, fuel and other costs for each vehicle. Km per litre uses only the rows where you typed litres.

sheet.title: Marks and Rank Sheet
sheet.intro: Type each student's marks and the sheet works out the total, percentage, pass or fail, grade and rank. Summary shows the class average, the highest marks and how many passed in each subject. Works in Excel, Google Sheets and WPS, without macros.
guide: Open Settings and type the sheet title, the maximum marks in each subject and the pass mark in percent. Check the grade scale below it and change it to your own.
Open Marks. Roll numbers and names are already there. Type each student's marks in each subject. Leave a box empty if the student did not take that subject.
Total, percentage, Pass or Fail, grade and rank fill in. A mark below the pass mark turns red, and a student with any red mark shows Fail.
Summary shows the number of students, how many passed, the pass rate, the class average, the topper and the average, highest and passes for each subject. Print the Marks sheet for the class.
guideHi: Settings mein sheet ka title, har subject ke maximum marks aur pass marks (percent mein) likhein. Neeche grade scale dekhein aur apne hisaab se badlein.
Marks kholein. Roll number aur naam pehle se hain. Har student ke har subject ke marks likhein. Agar student ne wo subject nahi liya to box khali chhod dein.
Total, percentage, Pass ya Fail, grade aur rank apne aap aate hain. Pass marks se kam marks laal ho jate hain, aur kisi bhi laal marks wala student Fail dikhta hai.
Summary mein students ki sankhya, kitne pass hue, pass rate, class average, topper aur har subject ka average, sabse zyada aur pass dikhte hain. Class ke liye Marks sheet print karein.
